'''Bulsar ''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One day, during a scheme orchestrated with his [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] partner and his [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] accomplice [[Netek]] to swindle [[Malrik]], Bulsar was playing [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] when he was accused of cheating. Malrik, suspicious of foul play, ordered a search. Bulsar was then apprehended and restrained by crewmen. Later, in the ship's hold, Bulsar calmly counted [[Credit chip/Legends|credit chips]] on top of a crate, grumbling about the plan.<ref name="Fly Casual" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bulsar was first mentioned in ''[[Fly Casual]]'', a [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="Fly Casual" />
